title: pax-beehive/paxm
claim: Local-first memory CLI that carries project decisions and conventions across Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Cursor, Cline and any MCP agent — SQLite, no account, no embeddings required.
why_good: Every agent vendor is building memory as lock-in; paxm is the neutral layer that follows the developer instead of the tool. “Stop re-explaining your project every session” is a pain every multi-agent dev hits daily — and 177 commits in 30 days says the author is sprinting.
value: The context store of the agent era — free local CLI, paid synced/team memory (shared org conventions across every agent seat). Whoever holds a team’s working memory owns brutal switching costs.
risk: Single maintainer, and every vendor (OpenAI, Anthropic, Cursor) ships default-on native memory. The neutral layer only matters if developers keep mixing agents — true today, not guaranteed.

zh.claim: 本地优先的记忆 CLI：把项目决策与工程约定带入 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode、Cursor、Cline 及任何 MCP 代理 — SQLite 本地存储，无需账号，也不依赖向量模型。
zh.why_good: 各家代理厂商都在把“记忆”做成锁定手段；paxm 是跟着开发者走而非跟着工具走的中立层。“不用每个会话重新解释项目”是多代理开发者每天的痛点，30 天 177 次提交说明作者在全速冲刺。
zh.value: 代理时代的上下文存储 — 本地 CLI 免费，付费提供同步/团队记忆（全团队每个代理席位共享工程约定）。谁掌握团队的工作记忆，谁就握有极高的切换成本。
zh.risk: 单人维护；且 OpenAI、Anthropic、Cursor 都在内置默认开启的原生记忆。中立层只有在开发者持续混用多个代理时才有价值 — 今天成立，未来未必。
